teacher_info.introduction: Welcome dear friends. My name is Ben. I have a BA degree in psychology and social behavior, MA in English Language Teaching, and a TEFL teaching certificate. I'm very patient, friendly (I like meeting new people), and eager to cooperate and teach students in a manner that is stress-free and encourages their language learning development. After having traveled abroad and living in a different country for 4 years I've came to realize that many people move to a new country completely unprepared and feel lost and worried. They do not have the survival English to find a job, call for an emergency, fill out a form, order food, find a special store, use a taxi, get directions or communicate efficiently at all . As a result, my lessons are heavily tailored to developing strong conversation or speaking skills (which develop all four skills speaking, listening, reading, writing) and also learning about the culture, thinking, and behavior of English speakers, and finally developing different lessons and materials based on whatever you need English for and in a manner where you will learn to become an independent English learner so you can feel as comfortable as a native English speaker without ever feeling like you're lost. Be patient and work hard with me and you'll learn how to survive and work with the English language, make good friends, enjoy the language and even use it to travel the world.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS or TOEFL Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Please choose a class based on the descriptions under the IELTS or TOEFL sections below.

IELTS:
This class is a simulation of the IELTS speaking test (General or Academic).  We will do this class as if we were at a testing center.  I designed the class in a similar format to the actual speaking test with three parts (timed) and a cue-card topic. 

Classes: 
• 30-minute class includes one (1) test simulation (one cue-card topic) and feedback
• 45-minute class includes two (2) test simulations (two cue-card topics) and feedback
• 60-minute class includes three (3) test simulations (three cue-card topics) and feedback
• Includes estimate of your speaking score based on the IELTS band scale (1-9)

TOEFL:
This class is a simulation of the TOEFL speaking task 1 question.  These questions will be in one of the following three formats: agree/disagree; paired-choice; or good idea.  I will ask you a question and you will have 15 seconds to prepare and then 45 seconds to answer the question.

Classes:
• 30-minute class includes 10 to 20 questions and feedback
• 45-minute class includes 15 to 30 questions and feedback
• 60-minute class includes 20 to 40 questions and  feedback

Additionally, I can help you prepare for the Integrated Speaking Task questions.

pro_course_detail.title: Cambridge A2 KET Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Cambridge KET Exam Preparation  

This course is designed to fully prepare your child for the Cambridge KET exam, ensuring they build a strong foundation in English. I use the Complete KET Student’s Book and Workbook to cover all essential grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Throughout the course, we will also incorporate practice tests to track progress and determine when your child is test-ready. If additional support is needed, we will use the Exam Booster for extra exam-style practice.  

The time required to prepare for KET depends on your child’s current level. It can take up to a year or more to fully develop the necessary skills to excel in the exam. My goal is not just to help them pass but to ensure they build a solid foundation for future exams like PET and FCE.  

Many students pass KET and PET based on their speaking ability alone, without mastering grammar. However, when they reach FCE, they struggle due to gaps in their grammar knowledge. That is why I emphasize a balanced approach, making sure your child is exposed to all key language areas so they can progress confidently through the Cambridge levels.  

By focusing on strong grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills in KET, your child will be well-prepared for future challenges. Investing in their foundation now will make their English journey smoother, and their future self will thank you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
I believe in keeping things simple and using clear, straightforward language to help you achieve your desired band score. Many people assume that using advanced vocabulary is necessary for a high score. While that can be true to some extent, if you are not able to use advanced words correctly, it may lower your score. That is why I focus on essential linking words that can effectively improve your performance.  

In our lessons, we will explore conditional sentences with "if" to discuss possible situations, helping you express ideas with confidence. We will also work on expanding your vocabulary with words like "more," which indicate an increase in quantity or degree, enriching your writing without making it too complex.  

A key part of our sessions will be learning how to connect and extend ideas smoothly. I will show you how to use "and" and "also" to add information naturally, and how to emphasize important points with "not only... but also." We will practice using "to" and "the" for clarity and specificity, and I will explain how "which" can be used to add extra details about a noun, making your sentences clearer and more precise.  

I will encourage you to reflect on your progress, helping you think carefully about what you have learned and how to apply it effectively. We will also work on cause and effect by using "because" to explain reasons, "therefore" to show logical conclusions, and "so" to indicate results, allowing you to create well-structured arguments.  

Finally, I will guide you in using "when" to refer to specific situations and teach you how to introduce contrasting ideas with "but" or "however." With this approach, you will not only prepare effectively for your exams but also develop a strong foundation in English.  

Together, we will work towards your success.
